QUOTE: By default, the field is renamed to `private_<name>`. Code that writes `ctx->md_info` fails to compile, while `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(md_info)` still works inside the library. It is a naming gate, not a real access control.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the compile-time enforcement works by renaming the member, not real access control. It never says the layout stays visible and sized, but "naming gate, not a real access control" carries the substance of the item.
